pages.lesson:
LESSON: SARUFI 4.4.1 NYAKATI NA HALI; ULIOPO ULIOPITA

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.4: Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali; uliopo uliopita

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali; uliopo uliopita. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kubainisha vitenzi vilivyo katika wakati uliopo uliopita na ujao katika matini
2. kutumia wakati uliopo, uliopita na ujao ifaavyo katika matini

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kubainisha vitenzi vilivyo katika wakati uliopo uliopita na ujao katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kubainisha vitenzi vilivyo katika wakati uliopo uliopita na ujao katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutumia wakati uliopo, uliopita na ujao ifaavyo katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia wakati uliopo, uliopita na ujao ifaavyo katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali; uliopo uliopita using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali; uliopo uliopita in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali; uliopo uliopita to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali; uliopo uliopita.
4. Show that you can: kubainisha vitenzi vilivyo katika wakati uliopo uliopita na ujao katika matini

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali; uliopo uliopita using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 4.4.1 Nyakati na Hali; uliopo uliopita important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kubainisha vitenzi vilivyo katika wakati uliopo uliopita na ujao katika matini
2. kutumia wakati uliopo, uliopita na ujao ifaavyo katika matini

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
